data.name: Duhat
data.short_meaning: Fruit of the tree of Zakkum
data.long_meaning: The name Duhat refers to the fruit of the tree of Zakkum mentioned in the Quran. This tree is described as having bitter and painful thorns, and its fruits are eaten by the people of Hell. The name is thus a reminder of the consequences of sin and the importance of living a righteous and obedient life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the consequences of sin and the importance of living a righteous and obedient life.

in_english.name: Duhat
in_english.meaning: A large tree providing shade and comfort
in_english.long_meaning: Duhat is derived from the Arabic root 'D-W-H' meaning a large tree that provides shade and comfort. It is mentioned in the Quran (Surah Yasin, verse 30) as a symbol of prosperity and spiritual growth. In Islamic tradition, Duhat represents a blessed tree, signifying refuge and solace. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, generosity, and a nurturing nature.
